title: AI Lays Off America While Apple Launches Siri
pattern: AI is no longer the future of work — it's the present reason people are losing it. But the people who thrive will be those who treat AI as a collaborator, not a replacement. The Great Repurpose isn't a luxury anymore; it's a survival skill.

stories.title: AI Overtakes All Other Reasons For US Job Cuts As Layoffs Surge In 2026
stories.summary: This is the labor-market alarm bell in plain language: AI is not just a tool companies are testing, it is becoming a reason companies give for cutting jobs. The emotional reality is that people are being forced to repurpose under pressure.
keyPoints: AI is being named as a leading driver of job cuts in the headline data.
The story moves AI displacement from future anxiety into present workforce planning.
TGR relevance: people need identity and value work before disruption becomes personal.

stories.title: Apple Introduces Siri AI, a Profoundly More Capable and Personal Assistant
stories.summary: A more capable Siri would put AI assistance deeper into the daily rhythm of ordinary users. The signal is mainstreaming: AI becomes less like a destination app and more like an always-available layer between intention and action.
keyPoints: Apple-style integration can make AI feel normal to people who never went looking for it.
The assistant layer will shape how people search, decide, communicate, and create.
This is Discover AI's Power with a human-agency question attached: who is steering the assistant?

stories.title: AI, Jobs, and the Next Generation
stories.summary: Microsoft framing AI and jobs for the next generation points to the education gap underneath the labor story. Young people do not just need tool familiarity. They need a way to build identity, judgment, and purpose in a market that keeps shifting.
keyPoints: The next generation is entering work at the same time AI is rewriting entry-level assumptions.
Education has to prepare people for judgment and adaptability, not only technical fluency.
TGR relevance: Find Your Purpose becomes a workforce skill, not a luxury.

stories.title: AI Isn't Replacing Creativity. It's Moving It Upstream.
stories.summary: The creative story gives the day its counterweight: even as AI pressures jobs, it can also move people toward higher-order creative judgment. The opportunity is real, but only for people willing to claim the directing role.
keyPoints: AI can make execution cheaper while increasing the value of taste and direction.
Creatives need to move upstream into intent, framing, and quality judgment.
This is Start Creating from a reclaimed sense of value.

stories.title: JPMorgan Chase Reclassifies AI as Core Infrastructure in $19.8B Tech Budget
stories.summary: When a major bank treats AI as core infrastructure, the workplace shift becomes structural. AI is no longer an innovation budget experiment. It is part of how the institution expects work to happen.
keyPoints: AI is being funded as foundational business infrastructure, not a side project.
Large institutions are preparing for operating-model change at serious scale.
TGR relevance: Discover AI's Power now means understanding the systems that will define future work.
